_comment: Sub-configuration formats and the parent filter overlay they specialise. compose-docs starts from the parent's composed doc and deep-merges the sub-config's own doc-overlay/filters/<id>.json (its tailored overview + any param-help deltas) on top. A sub-config SHOULD still ship its own overlay file with aliasOf set and a tailored overview; if none exists, it inherits the parent verbatim. Orphan formats with no parent are NOT listed here — they get a standalone overlay.
